question: Please provide the top 10 tree species in New York, using their uppercase Latin names where the Latin name is not empty and including their common names, showing the total number of trees, the counts of alive and dead trees for each year, and the corresponding growth in these counts from 1995 to 2015, then order by the difference in total tree counts between these years.
sql:
WITH 
census_1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin_upper,
    COUNT(*) AS total_1995,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Fair', 'Critical', 'Poor') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_1995,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_1995
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin_upper,
    COUNT(*) AS total_2015,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_2015,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_2015
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
species_common AS (
  SELECT 
    spc_latin_upper,
    spc_common,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY spc_latin_upper ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin_upper,
      spc_common,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
    WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
    GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), spc_common
  )
)
SELECT 
  c1.spc_latin_upper,
  sc.spc_common AS common_name,
  c1.total_1995,
  c2.total_2015,
  c1.alive_1995,
  c2.alive_2015,
  c1.dead_1995,
  c2.dead_2015,
  c2.total_2015 - c1.total_1995 AS total_growth,
  c2.alive_2015 - c1.alive_1995 AS alive_growth,
  c2.dead_2015 - c1.dead_1995 AS dead_growth
FROM census_1995 c1
INNER JOIN census_2015 c2 ON c1.spc_latin_upper = c2.spc_latin_upper
INNER JOIN species_common sc ON c1.spc_latin_upper = sc.spc_latin_upper AND sc.rn = 1
ORDER BY total_growth DESC
LIMIT 10

    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_1995
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin_upper,
    COUNT(*) AS total_2015,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_2015,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_2015
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
species_common AS (
  SELECT 
    spc_latin_upper,
    spc_common,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY spc_latin_upper ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin_upper,
      spc_common,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
    WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
    GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), spc_common
  )
)
SELECT 
  c1.spc_latin_upper,
  sc.spc_common AS common_name,
  c1.total_1995,
  c2.total_2015,
  c1.alive_1995,
  c2.alive_2015,
  c1.dead_1995,
  c2.dead_2015,
  c2.total_2015 - c1.total_1995 AS total_growth,
  c2.alive_2015 - c1.alive_1995 AS alive_growth,
  c2.dead_2015 - c1.dead_1995 AS dead_growth
FROM census_1995 c1
INNER JOIN census_2015 c2 ON c1.spc_latin_upper = c2.spc_latin_upper
INNER JOIN species_common sc ON c1.spc_latin_upper = sc.spc_latin_upper AND sc.rn = 1
ORDER BY total_growth DESC
LIMIT 10
